name: Imix
tactics: Liquid fire erupts in a massive column, washing the area with punishing heat. After a moment, a huge humanoid armed with a blazing blade steps from the flames. Imix mocks his enemies, his voice crackling with the sound of killing fire. With every dread elemental power he unleashes, Imix derides his enemies. Yet in spite of his boasts, Imix is quick to bring up reinforcements. Gouts of flame burst around him and coalesce into fire grues, blazing forms that dance to Imix’s whims, caressing foes with fire as they gloat and cackle. Throughout battle, Imix occasionally throws up his hands, causing one of his grues to explode. He uses his grues to create bubbling pools of molten rock to scorch his foes while unleashing tongues of flame that immolate victims. Imix isn’t afraid to engage enemies in melee, wielding a blade formed from his elemental essence. Imix is cunning, but he is also arrogant and views mortals as no threat. Imix presses the attack even after a battle turns against him, fleeing only when his death becomes a real possibility.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Withering Flames
traits.details: Enemies within the aura do not benefit from fire resistance.

auras.name: Withering Flames
auras.details: Enemies within the aura do not benefit from fire resistance.

hit.description: fire damage, and ongoing 20 fire damage (save ends).

effect.description: Imix uses blazing blade against each enemy within reach.
Imix reduces a fire grue within 10 squares of him to 0 hit points and makes the following attack centered on the grue.
The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. Any enemy that enters the zone or ends its turn there takes 20 fire damage.

powers.name: Servants of Elemental Fire (fire)
powers.usageDetails: when no fire grue is within 10 squares of Imix at the start of his turn

effect.description: Imix creates four fire grues, or six while Imix is bloodied, each in an unoccupied square within 10 squares of him. The grues cannot take actions. Any creature that starts its turn adjacent to one or more grues takes 15 fire damage. The grues have defenses equal to Imix’s and 1 hit point each. A missed attack never damages a grue. Each grue lasts until the end of the encounter or until Imix ends his turn more than 10 squares from it. As a minor action, Imix can move each grue up to 6 squares.

hit.description: fire damage, and the target is blinded (save ends).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of Imix’s next turn.

hit.description: The target is weakened (save ends). Each creature adjacent to at least one target takes 10 fire damage.

powers.name: Demand Focus
powers.trigger: An enemy willingly moves away from a fire grue without shifting.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: the triggering enemy in the burst

hit.description: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn.

powers.name: Formed of Fire
powers.trigger: An enemy misses Imix with a melee attack.

effect.description: The triggering enemy and each of its adjacent allies take 10 fire damage.

powers.name: Eternal Resilience
powers.trigger: Imix is affected by an effect that a save can end.

effect.description: Imix makes a saving throw against the effect.
